definitions.explanation: A black cricket native to Japan, famous for the clear, bell-like sound the males produce in late summer and early autumn. Sometimes kept as a pet for its song.

examples.japanese: {鈴虫|すずむし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。

examples.english: Hearing the sound of bell crickets makes me feel that autumn has come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{鈴虫|すずむし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}って→飼う：08151_kau⟧、{涼|すず}しげな⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather keeps bell crickets every year and enjoys their cool-sounding song.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧ (bell) + ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (insect), named for the bell-like ringing sound the males make by rubbing their wings together. Their song is a classic seasonal marker of late summer and early autumn in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鈴虫|すずむし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the song of bell crickets
- {鈴虫|すずむし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧: bell crickets chirp
- {鈴虫|すずむし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep bell crickets as pets

CULTURAL NOTE:
The sound of bell crickets is deeply associated with autumn in Japanese poetry and culture. The verb ⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧ (to cry/sing/chirp) is the standard word for the sound — never use ⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {松虫|まつむし}: pine cricket — another singing insect of autumn, often paired with {鈴虫|すずむし}
- ⟦コオロギ→コオロギ：29902_koorogi⟧: cricket — broader term covering many species including this one
